title: 23 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of deities to be installed in BAPS hari mandirs in Memnagar (Amdavad), Odhav (Amdavad), Khoraj and Sector 22, Gandhinagar
story:
After concluding his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of deities to be installed in BAPS hari mandirs in Memnagar (Amdavad), Odhav (Amdavad), Khoraj and Sector 22, Gandhinagar.

At about 10.00 am Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of ‘Jivan Sandhya Kutir’ (home for senior citizens) and also inaugurated the newly built student’s hostel called ‘Ishavasyam Chhatralay’ of Hiramani Vidyalay in Chharodi on the outskirts of Amdavad. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the assembly of dignitaries and blessed Shri Narharibhai Amin, the president and proprietor of the Hiramani Educational Trust.

K.K. Shastri and Devkinandan Dwivedi light the traditional lamp to inaugurate the Golden Anniversary conference of the Akhil Bharatiya Darshan Parishad at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Amdavad. Performs the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandirs (sanskardhams) for Memnagar and Odhav suburbs. During the inauguration of Hiramani Chhatralay (school hostel) and then blesses the assembly. Blesses the satsang assembly. In a jovial mood during an assembly. Performs arti of Shakotsav. Arrives for darshan at the historic Ambli Vali Pol. Departs from Ambli Vali Pol. At the Ambli Vali Pol. On stage during the inaugural session. Variety of fresh vegetables offered to Thakorji on Kartak sud Ekadashi (Shakotsav). Balaks with Bapa after their performance.

Engrossed in darshan of Thakorji. Performs the morning arti. Performs his daily puja. Blesses a child.

Greets bhaktas with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Engrossed in darshan in the room of gurus Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Bapa and sadguru sadhus on stage during the assembly.

Pujya Swayamprakash Swami (Doctor Swami) addresses the assembly. Youths perform a traditional dance.
